column1: # FungiFunk_refdb explicit strain / assembly target template
# This same TSV schema is used by:
# The command-line option determines whether every row in the supplied file is
# an inclusion or an exclusion. If both actions are needed, create and supply
# separate include and exclude TSV files.
#     - At least one of Species or Taxid is required.
#     - The accession must be an exact versioned GCF/GCA accession, for example
#     - Species, Taxid and Strain are optional identity hints. When supplied,
#       they are validated against the resolved NCBI record.
# Evidence_type and Notes are optional provenance fields.
# Blank lines and lines beginning with # are ignored.
# Examples below are comments only; replace them with real targets.
